Picks the curve that the volume of 3D sounds falls off by with distance, for the channels that start after the call. Channels that already play keep theirs, see [SetChannelFalloff](SetChannelFalloff). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; The curve of the original Blitz3D (FMOD 3), full volume up to a meter and then meters ^ -rolloff.
SetFalloff 1
listener = CreateListener(camera)
```
@param mode  `0` is the curve of this runtime, `1` the curve of the original and `2` the curve of SoLoud, see [CreateListener](CreateListener). Anything else is a runtime error.
@gap Without a call the default is `0`, or what the environment variable `BLITZLLVM_VOLUME_FALLOFF` says, see [Environment variables](Environment-Variables). The call wins over the variable.
